seo.title: About | Universal Equity Management Solutions
seo.description: UEMS bridges complex legal frameworks and seamless equity administration for companies of every scale and industry.

title: Empowering businesses
with transparent,
compliant *equity solutions.*
lede: We bridge the gap between complex legal frameworks and seamless equity administration for companies of every scale and industry.

story.big: Managing equity shouldn’t be a web of fragmented spreadsheets, compliance risk and administrative friction.
story.paragraphA: Founded by industry experts in corporate finance and venture governance, UEMS was built to turn equity management into a strategic advantage, not an afterthought.
story.missionText: is to help founders and investors navigate capitalisation with confidence: the right structure, the right records, and the right people around every transaction.

steps.title: Equity Advisory
steps.text: Capital-structure strategy, valuation scenarios, dilution and restructuring.

steps.title: Equity Management
steps.text: Cap tables, shareholder records, ESOPs, round history and investor reporting.

steps.title: Transaction Facilitation
steps.text: Coordinating CA, CS, legal counsel, valuers and regulated intermediaries where required.

agnostic.title: Equity structure is the backbone of your ownership governance.
agnostic.lede: Our facilitation service creates transparent liquidity pathways for all stakeholders, whatever you build.

items.title: Integrity & Accuracy
items.text: A zero-tolerance approach to capitalisation errors and governance oversights. Every share, every percentage, reconciled.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Clear ownership visualisation for all stakeholders, fostering long-term trust between founders, investors and teams.

items.title: Security
items.text: Strict access controls and confidential handling safeguard your sensitive financial and ownership data.

reasons.title: Why work with us?
items: Custom equity frameworks tailored to tech startups, manufacturing enterprises, founders & investors.
Local regulatory alignment, executed alongside licensed CA, CS and legal professionals.
Hands-on guidance from equity specialists who assist at every stage of your requirements.
